title: Hernando County School Board, District 5
what_it_does: School board members set the district budget and school-tax rate, hire the superintendent (where appointed), approve school boundaries, curriculum policy and construction, and set district policies. Nonpartisan.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); both candidates are marked Qualified, which for a nonpartisan seat means the August vote did not produce a majority winner (or the seat is decided only in November). Check the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Kara Champion
candidates.occupation: Works in her family's business, American Gun & Pawn
candidates.background: Kara Champion, 28, is a 2020 University of Central Florida graduate whose primary income comes from her family's business, American Gun & Pawn. She is the daughter of Hernando County Commissioner Steve Champion, has a stepdaughter in Hernando County schools and a young son. She finished the August 2026 primary three votes ahead of incumbent Susan Duval.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

school_safety.summary: Champion campaigns on stronger classroom discipline along with a return to reading, writing, mathematics and civics.

sources.title: Champion vs. Duval: School Board Race Offers Hernando Voters a Sharp Political Contrast

education_choice.summary: Champion says she supports parental choice but has also called for stronger oversight of the state's voucher programs, and wants the district to ask charter and private schools why families are enrolling there.
education_choice.quote: Why enrollment rates in public schools are down, while enrollment at charters and privates are going up

sources.title: Three seats on the Hernando County School Board are up for election this year

other_issues.title: Parental involvement and transparency
other_issues.summary: Champion campaigns on parents having a stronger voice in their children's education and on district transparency. She posted on her campaign Facebook page: 'We all want high-quality education for our children. We don't want indoctrination or politics.'

sources.title: Three seats on the Hernando County School Board are up for election this year

candidates.name: Susan Duval
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Retired school principal; Hernando County School Board member, District 5
candidates.background: Susan Duval, 79, began teaching in Hernando County schools in 1969 and served 11 years as principal of Springstead High School before retiring. She was first elected to the District 5 school board seat in 2014 and is seeking a fourth term. She trailed challenger Kara Champion by three votes in the August 2026 primary.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

education_choice.summary: On May 26, 2026, Duval cast the lone vote against each of three charter school applications (two You Thrive academies and a Pineapple Cove Classical Academy replication), which the board approved 4-1. She said the state was effectively forcing districts to approve them, while other members said they welcomed charter competition.
education_choice.quote: The state is telling not only this district but every school district what they can and can’t do in terms of just about anything anymore,

sources.title: Board approves three new charter schools (Tampa Bay Beacons / Hernando Today)

other_issues.title: Competing with charter and private schools
other_issues.summary: Duval says the district needs to do a better job of marketing itself because public schools are 'not the only option in town anymore,' and describes her role as representing every student: 'As a board member, we're looking out for all students, not some of them. All of them.'

sources.title: Three seats on the Hernando County School Board are up for election this year

record.item: May 2023: voted with a unanimous board to remove Rupi Kaur's 'The Sun and Her Flowers' from school libraries, while saying the review committee had found the poetry content appropriate and the complaints concerned the book's images.

sources.title: Hundreds gather into the wee hours at a contentious Hernando County School Board meeting (WUSF)

record.item: May 2023: voted with the 3-2 majority against a 'no confidence' motion on then-Superintendent John Stratton.
